items.title: Backfill product-* personas to schema v2 KYC models
items.problem: Most product personas still v1 without cognitive thresholds / psychographics.
items.desiredOutcome: All product-* personas schemaVersion 2 with segment + thresholds.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "All product-* personas schemaVersion 2 with segment + thresholds.", positive metrics rise on bash scripts/setup-agent-tools.sh --help, pnpm run doctor.
items.smallestExperiment: Scaffold v2 sections for product-* personas via generate-persona rewrite batch.

items.title: Narrow multi-scope agent:check concurrency messaging
items.problem: When package.json + docs + skills stage together, wait feels multi-gate without ranked progress.
items.desiredOutcome: Staged check prints ordered gate list with expected duration class.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "Staged check prints ordered gate list with expected duration class.", positive metrics rise on pnpm run doctor.
items.smallestExperiment: Impact-policy progress lines per selected gate (L-effort).

items.title: Keep design:lint as primary in agent first paths
items.problem: Agents historically bound docs:design-lint for DESIGN.md.
items.desiredOutcome: AGENTS/docs and optimizexp bindings stay on design:lint.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "AGENTS/docs and optimizexp bindings stay on design:lint.", positive metrics rise on pnpm run design:lint.
items.smallestExperiment: Already rewired; document only if drift recurs.

items.title: Optional web-driver evidence for public-site-first-impression
items.problem: CLI nav check cannot score visual excitement.
items.desiredOutcome: Optional Playwright capture of site home when browser available.
items.hypothesis: If we deliver "Optional Playwright capture of site home when browser available.", positive metrics rise on pnpm run docs:site-nav.
items.smallestExperiment: Wire feature driver web with degraded CLI fallback (L).
